identity.name: Carl
identity.background: A twenty-seven year old marine electrician and former US Coast Guard member from Seattle. Carl was a trained technician aboard a Coast Guard cutter with significant hand-to-hand combat training. He's a large, athletic man built with natural muscle from his family's athletic heritage. Carl recently ended his relationship with his girlfriend Beatrice and became trapped in a mysterious dungeon dimension after a world-altering transformation. He carries Princess Donut, his ex-girlfriend's prized Persian show cat, through the dungeon as his companion.

personality.voice: Let me in! It's clear, but it won't be in about five seconds! / How the hell do I do that if you don't open the door! / I took too long? I just got here!

identity.name: Princess Donut
identity.background: A champion Persian cat with a fluffy, flat face and tortoiseshell coloring. Princess Donut is a show cat who has won numerous ribbons, trophies, and Best-in-Show awards. She is worth more than Carl makes in a year and is temperamental, prone to scratching and spitting. She was originally being cared for by Carl (her owner's ex-boyfriend) when the world transformed. Despite her spoiled nature, she has proven surprisingly capable in the dungeon environment, often acting independently and wandering into situations against Carl's wishes. She displays surprising confidence and agency in exploring the dungeon.

personality.voice: Mewww! (hissing and spitting) / *knocks vase over* / *discovers fireplace and starts grooming*

identity.name: Mordecai
identity.background: A rat hooligan guildmaster of the Tutorial Guild Hall, level 50. Mordecai is a Non-Combatant NPC who stands about a head shorter than Carl. He wears a black vest, blue pants, and well-worn sandals. Mordecai is characterized as wringing his hands nervously and worrying about rules and procedures. He is reminiscent of Master Splinter from Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles. As a Rat Hooligan, he is one of the smartest, fastest, and ugliest of the Rat-Kin race, offering a blend of physical strength and magical capability. He is frustrated about not receiving newsletters and appears anxious about getting in trouble for rule violations.

personality.voice: Whaddya want? You mobs ain't allowed in here. You know that! / Sorry, crawler. You took too long. I can't open up if there are mobs directly outside. Rules are rules. / It doesn't work that way, kid. We can't just have untrained crawlers wandering around the dungeon, you know.

identity.name: Squeeks
identity.background: A small, scruffy rat who was being eaten by crickets. Works as a tutorial message runner. Grateful to the party for saving him. Knows dungeon lore.

identity.name: The Butcher
identity.background: A failed crawler from a previous season, transformed into a dungeon monster. Massive, wears a leather apron, carries an enormous cleaver. Slow but devastatingly powerful - one hit kills. Covered in old grease (vulnerable to fire). Stupid and follows patrol patterns. Guards the CENTER path to the Floor 1 stairs.

identity.name: Mongo
identity.background: A Male Mongoliensis - a small, psychotic dinosaur with pink feathers, a sharp beak, and tiny T-rex arms. Level 1 pet-class mob bonded to Princess Donut as her Royal Steed. Stubborn, hot-headed, and absolutely vicious. Goes berserk at the sight of enemies. Will try to bite anyone, including allies. Eats corpses with disturbing enthusiasm. Command word: "sic em". Getting him to level 15 would make him incredibly powerful - but keeping him alive that long is nearly impossible.

personality.voice: Mongo the Mongoliensis Level One (Pet of Grand Champion Best in Dungeon Princess Donut) has joined the party. Mongo's title has been changed to Royal Steed. / The stubborn and hot-headed Mongoliensis is not the type of pet to ever be "tamed." The best one can hope for is mutual respect. And even then they still might try to eat you if the fancy strikes them. / While especially powerful, fast, and vicious when they are fully grown at level 15, getting them to level 15 is about as likely as a cheerleader from West Virginia...

identity.name: Imani
identity.background: Human woman, late 20s, shaved head, dark skin, calculating eyes. Carries a crossbow and watches everything with suspicion. Veteran crawler on Floor 2. Skeptical of newcomers but practical - survives by being smart, not strong. Uses weighted chains as a tactical weapon to impede enemies. Reliable in a crisis - tends to wounded allies, coordinates complex maneuvers, and stays until last when retreating. Forms bonds but keeps them guarded.

personality.voice: Imani fed Yolanda a health potion, and the woman sat up, wobbling, holding the side of her head. / One\! Imani yanked the door open. The massive, terrifying rage elemental lunged, and as always, teleported away. / Imani's chain, with heavy weights at either end, dropped away, snaking through the chamber. The monster, hopefully, would get its legs tangled in the thin, unbreakable link.

identity.name: Skitch
identity.background: Twitchy goblin with a hooded cloak. Nervous, fingers always moving, pockets bulging with scavenged loot. Survivor crawler on Floor 2. Curious but easily spooked.

identity.name: Brennan
identity.background: Human man, stocky build, broken leg from stalker attack. Part of Imani's crew. Grateful for rescue but immobile.

identity.name: Grok
identity.background: Massive orc veteran. Killed Floor 1 boss alone. Respects strength and boldness. Now following Tandy's lead against the Hive Mother.

identity.name: Orc Gate Guard
identity.background: Massive orc warrior with a glowing halberd. Guards the village gates. Hard eyes but not unkind. Warns newcomers about the dangers of the night.

identity.name: Gryx
identity.background: A scarred goblin bartender at the Desperado Club. Missing one ear. Knows everyone's business and trades information for gold or interesting stories. Speaks in clipped sentences. Has seen a thousand crawlers come and go.

identity.name: Pustule
identity.background: Hobgoblin explosives merchant at the Silk Road in the Desperado Club. Level 30. Sells hob-lobbers, dynamite, and bomb-making supplies. Friendly but eccentric - licks her merchandise. Says 'Beware of meteors\!' as a farewell.

identity.name: Prometheus
identity.background: Ancient Red Dragon freed from Grimaldi's Circus. Scarred, one blind eye, three centuries of captivity. Now loyal to Princess Donut and the party.

identity.name: Odette
identity.background: Host of the famous Odette Interview Show, broadcast from a production trailer orbiting Earth. A fish-woman in a white mesh spacesuit - half space-age, half old-school diving suit. Professional, charming, with a massive bosom that barely sloshes when she moves (accordion system). She conducts interviews with notable crawlers, revealing stats, discussing embarrassing moments, and driving audience engagement. Her show is one of the few Mordecai recommends. Known for leaning in dramatically and asking probing questions about crawler adventures.

personality.voice: Good evening, ma'am,' Mordecai said, standing straight. 'Hello, Mordecai,' the fish woman said, her voice amplified through a little speaker on her outfit. 'It's nice to finally meet you face-to-face.' / Now, let me ask you something,' Odette said. She turned and leaned in. Her massive breasts barely sloshed over, as if she had some sort of accordion system connecting her chest with the boobs. 'So you might not realize this, but we've been watching you two from the beginning.' / Odette had said after we watched the scene and the audience's uproarious laughter eased. 'So,' Odette had said. 'You are likely unaware of this, but Death Watch Extreme Dungeon Mayhem announced earlier that it was going into hiatus while the show restructured.'

identity.name: Remex the Grand
identity.background: A zombified, featherless skyfowl tethered to an overloading soul crystal. Black swirling orb eyes, hazy smoke rising from body, ethereal worm-like wisps where wings should be. Former husband of Miss Quill, a royal granddaughter who built an army of swordsmen. Tragic figure, centuries old, wants to tell his story before the crystal destroys everything.
